svg.title: Channel importance and INT4 quality
svg.text: Which weights matter: how hard each input channel of layer 1's down_proj is driven
Mean x² per channel on calibration text (log scale). A weight in an amber column meets an activation
thousands of times larger than usual, so its rounding error is multiplied by that much in the output.
INT4 quality, step by step (mean KL divergence from the original model; shorter is better)
